title: Syracuse police refuse to give city’s watchdog board any records needed for investigations
summary: Syracuse Police Department refused to provide records to the city's police watchdog board needed to investigate 11 officer complaints. This represents a significant transparency and accountability issue that directly impacts the oversight mechanisms designed to ensure police department accountability and public trust.

political_signal.description: Public accountability mechanism (watchdog board) being obstructed by police department; indicates potential governance failure and lack of transparency in police oversight structures.
